subject.size_in_frame: seen from below and behind, about 0.45 of frame height at the start, settling to 0.38 as the walls open out

headroom: she is held central with about 0.30 of frame height of receding shaft above her — occupied entirely by the shrinking tunnel mouth, which is the measure of how far she has already come.
horizon_eyeline: No horizon and no level reference of any kind: the frame contains only the shaft's converging walls and the circle above. Her face is away from camera, so there is no eyeline in frame at all.

layers.fg: glazed cupboard doors and the near shelf edges sliding up past the bottom and side edges, closest and fastest
layers.mg: Alice's back, skirts billowing, hair pulling up toward the top of frame
layers.bg: the tunnel mouth shrinking away above her at frame centre, a small ring of daylight, and the first pass of rows of stoneware jars with honey-gold still surviving on the topmost shelves

gaze.note: the audience's attention, not hers, is sent upward: she is tight on her back and the only thing to look at above her is the closing circle she came from.

balance: Radially symmetrical around the vertical centre line — figure centred, shaft centred, receding circle centred. Locked and calm, so that the only unease available is the rate at which the circle gets smaller.
leading_lines: Every wall line, shelf edge and cupboard rail converges on the tunnel mouth at centre; the shaft is a single perspective funnel. Her floating hair points along the same axis.
eye_first: Her lit back at centre, then up the converging shelves to the shrinking mouth of daylight.
constraint_binding: No horizon, no Dutch, no spinning camera — the frame is held square and level for all seven seconds and every scrap of movement in the composition belongs to the dressing. Pass 1 only: glazed cupboards and stoneware jars, no bookshelf, map or picture peg is allowed into frame.
